text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp has finally arrived. As for 
Admire Vega, she was helping the class 
representative, Narita Top Road, take 
attendance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sensing that the distance between him and 
his peers was naturally closing— the days 
of rigorous training for the Kikuka Sho 
began.
